messages:
Ellie: FYI my birthday is Wed Aug 7 63
(yes, the middle of the week, sorry) 5B. I'm planning to be in-office that day 382 ")
Sam: happy early! do you want cupcakes at lunch or a quick stand-up celebration?
Ellie: probably cupcakes at 12:30 + a 10-min toast in the kitchen. nothing fancy. also low-sugar options please if possible
Riya: I'll bring gluten-free mini cupcakes. what flavor do you prefer? chocolate, lemon, or mixed?
Ellie: mixed would be perfect 60a
Ben: I can handle decorations and the card. poll: 1) cupcakes only 2) cupcakes + streamers 3) cupcakes + tiny banner. reply with 1/2/3
Carmen: 2
Riya: 1
Ben: votes: 2 (Carmen), 1 (Riya). still open.
Ellie: if someone's baking, please keep nut-free. I telework mornings but will be around after 11:45. no need to spend more than $25 total :)
Sam: I'll buy a small reusable plant for the desk if everyone is cool with that. cheap and eco-friendly :seedling:
CalendarBot: Event created: "Ellie Bday Lunch"  Wed Aug 7 12:30 PM  Kitchen Area. Invite: #random. Note: "Ellie present, bring low-sugar options"
Ben: final: cupcakes at 12:30, streamers, small plant from Sam, card by Carmen. I'll put up a quick note in the office calendar and stash napkins.
Riya: baking will start at 10:30, dropping at 12:10. DM me if you want to contribute to ingredients.
Carmen: I'll circulate the card around 11:45 for signatures.
Ellie: omg you all. virtual high-five for remote folks: https://zoom.us/j/elliebday at 12:35 for 5 minutes if anyone remote wants to say hi :heart:
Sam: sending a :cake: gif in thread. see you Wednesday!
Ben: added a :thumbsup: reaction to the event. thanks team, excited to celebrate."
